note: Independent rejudge against RFC 2866 Section 3 ("If the packet is shorter than the Length field indicates, it MUST be silently discarded."). In 1b0198fb0d, TestRFC2866ShortPacketSilentlyDiscarded was strengthened: against an Accounting-Response whose Length is overstated by 8, with Retries=2 it now asserts both that SendToServers fails AND that the server received 2 requests (original + retransmission), proving silent discard in readLoop/VerifyResponseAuth/Decode rather than immediate abort. TestRFC2866HonestLengthIsAccepted proves the same server with an honest Length completes. Verdict enforced stands.
